title: The muddy children
intro: Three children played in the garden; two of them have mud on their foreheads. Each child sees the others but not herself. The father announces: at least one of you is muddy. Then he asks again and again: does anyone know whether she is muddy? Each answer is heard by all. Move the slider to add the announcements one by one and watch the possible worlds disappear.
knowsLabel: Child 1 knows whether she is muddy (1 = yes)
sceneTitle: The possible worlds and what each child cannot tell apart
checkKnows: Child 1 knows whether she is muddy.
